'''Battleground: Hoth''' was a casual Swiss tournament held on 15 December 2019 at the Fantasy Flight Games Center in Roseville, Minnesota, focused on cards from Episodes IV–VI with Hoth as the battleground. Six players took part. Michael finished first and won an unopened sealed deck.<ref name="bgh">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=73954 Battleground: Hoth, Minneapolis MN, Dec. 15th], forum.starwarsccg.org (10 November – 28 December 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105005021/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t73954.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Fantasy Flight Games Center, Roseville, Minnesota<ref name="bgh" />
* '''Date:''' 15 December 2019<ref name="bgh" />
* '''Structure:''' 4 games Swiss, each player playing each side twice, with a small ban list<ref name="bgh" />
* '''Field:''' 6 players<ref name="bgh" />

== Results ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Finish !! Player
|-
| 1 || Michael
|}

On the Light Side, Ming and [[Scott Atkins]] played Tauntaun decks, Michael played speeders with power harpoons, Craig played a Han deck and Paul played artillery weapons. The Dark Side decks were mostly walkers aimed at the generators. Scott Atkins wrote the event summary.<ref name="bgh" />
